name: 3D Gaussian Unscented Transform (3DGUT)
definition: A rasterization-based rendering technique for 3D Gaussian particles that replaces the EWA splatting formulation with the Unscented Transform (UT). It approximates 3D Gaussian particles using sigma points to enable exact projection under arbitrary nonlinear camera projections (e.g., distorted cameras, rolling shutter) and aligns the rendering formulation with ray-tracing methods to support secondary rays.
summary: 3DGUT is a rasterization technique that projects 3D Gaussian particles using sigma points to enable exact rendering under arbitrary non-linear camera models.
